import mujoco

class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;m=self.m;d=self.d
  self.jids=m.actuator_trnid[:21,0];self.qadr=m.jnt_qposadr[self.jids];self.vadr=m.jnt_dofadr[self.jids]
  self.q0=d.qpos[self.qadr].copy();self.target=np.zeros(m.nu);self.target[:21]=self.q0
  self.prevcom=d.subtree_com[1].copy();self.footref=d.site_xpos[1:3].mean(0).copy();self.J=np.zeros((12,m.nv))
 def gravity(self):
  m=self.m;d=self.d;J=self.J
  for j,site in enumerate([1,2]):mujoco.mj_jacSite(m,d,J[j*6:j*6+3],J[j*6+3:j*6+6],site)
  f=np.linalg.lstsq(J[:,:6].T,d.qfrc_bias[:6],rcond=None)[0]
  return d.qfrc_bias-J.T@f
 def action(self,q=None,k=150,kv=50):
  m=self.m;d=self.d;target=self.target.copy()

  com=d.subtree_com[1];vel=(com-self.prevcom)/.02;self.prevcom=com.copy()
  g=self.gravity()[self.vadr]
  target[:21]+=g/m.actuator_gainprm[:21,0]
  dx=com[0]-self.footref[0]
  target[[4,9]]+=(k*dx+kv*vel[0])/40
  return np.clip(self.s.low.task.normalize_action(target),-1,1)

def run(k=150,kv=50,save=False):

 return t,s
if __name__=='__main__':
